# nutanix_subnet (Resource)

Manages a Nutanix Networking v4.3 subnet.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Subnet name.
- `subnet_type` (String) Subnet type: `VLAN` or `OVERLAY`.

### Optional

- `bridge_name` (String) Host bridge name.
- `cluster_reference` (String) Cluster UUID.
- `description` (String) Subnet description.
- `is_advanced_networking` (Boolean) Whether advanced networking is enabled.
- `is_external` (Boolean) Whether the subnet is used for external connectivity.
- `is_nat_enabled` (Boolean) Whether NAT is enabled for the subnet.
- `network_id` (Number) VLAN ID or overlay VNI assigned by Networking.
- `virtual_switch_reference` (String) Virtual switch UUID.
- `vpc_reference` (String) VPC UUID.

### Read-Only

- `ext_id` (String) Networking subnet external UUID.
- `id` (String) Terraform identity, equal to the Networking subnet `extId`.
